name: Glances
tagline: All-in-one system monitor in your browser
description: Cross-platform system monitoring: CPU, memory, disks, network, sensors, processes — with web UI and alerting.
compose:
services:
  glances:
    image: nicolargo/glances:latest-full
    pid: host
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:61208"
    environment:
      GLANCES_OPT: "-w"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      - ./data:/root/.config/glances
    restart: unless-stopped
